Julia asks the three agents when offline mode should ship, each answers from its own laptop, eng and product settle the dates between them, and Jodee answers Julia.

eval:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Resize the open tabs"]'); if (!s) return; const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.x, clientY: r.y + 10 })); const box = s.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: box.left + box.width * 0.38 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {})); })()

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
